value.rationale: Maximal cyclic tomography is motivated by geometric direction economy. The first nonelementary rank-two abelian p-group has a complete, nontrivial two-scale Fourier spectrum: all 2p directions are indispensable while the exceptional p-1 characters force an unavoidable sqrt(p) stability barrier under positive scalar direction weights. This gives an exact all-prime structural and acquisition-design result, not a single finite table or routine numerical increment.
